about: Allowed findings of tools/check_roads.py (loop 3a). Every entry: the rule, where (map metres) and how far it reaches, optionally a name the finding must contain, why it is allowed and the source that shows it. Remove an entry when its cause is fixed (check_roads prints entries that no longer match anything).
